originalTitle: Elon Musk’s attempt at an AI Wikipedia hasn’t been updated in months

content: xAI’s Grokipedia, an online encyclopedia with AI-generated articles that Elon Musk once promised would be a “massive improvement” over Wikipedia, apparently hasn’t been updated since April 24th, according to a report from Lawfare. “As far as we can tell, no entry has changed in more than three months,” Lawfare said. Grokipedia launched in v0.1 in October 2025 with an initial batch of 885,000 articles, and is now on v0.2 (released in November 2025) and has more than 6,000,000 total articles, according to grokipedia.com/live. But that live page also has a section titled “Recent changes to…” with a message under it that reads “No live edits available right now.” You can still suggest articles for Grokipedia to cover and edits to individual pages. But Lawfare looked at both popular and unpopular pages on Grokipedia and found that they weren’t updating. “In our subsequent analysis of 34,519 pages with at least one suggested edit in our sample, containing a total of 225,496 recommended edits, we found no accepted or rejected corrections dated within the past three months,” Lawfare said. xAI didn’t immediately reply to a request for comment. Users on Reddit and X have wondered if Grokipedia is “dead.” Lawfare also noted that Musk’s last X post mentioning Grokipedia was from February.

chineseContent: 根据 Lawfare 的一份报告，xAI 的 Grokipedia 是一本包含人工智能生成文章的在线百科全书，埃隆·马斯克曾承诺这将是对维基百科的“巨大改进”，但自 4 月 24 日以来显然没有更新过。 “据我们所知，三个多月以来没有任何条目发生变化，”劳法尔说。根据 grokipedia.com/live 的数据，Grokipedia 于 2025 年 10 月推出 v0.1，首批文章数量为 885,000 篇，现在推出 v0.2（于 2025 年 11 月发布），文章总数超过 6,000,000 篇。但该实时页面还有一个标题为“最近更改...”的部分，其下方有一条消息，上面写着“目前没有可用的实时编辑”。您仍然可以建议 Grokipedia 覆盖和编辑各个页面的文章。但 Lawfare 查看了 Grokipedia 上热门和不受欢迎的页面，发现它们没有更新。 Lawfare 表示：“在我们对样本中至少包含一项建议编辑的 34,519 个页面进行的后续分析中，总共包含 225,496 个建议编辑，我们发现过去三个月内没有接受或拒绝的更正。” xAI 没有立即回复置评请求。 Reddit 和 X 上的用户想知道 Grokipedia 是否已经“死亡”。 Lawfare 还指出，马斯克最后一次提到 Grokipedia 的 X 帖子是在 2 月份。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
